comments.author: @phreshprince6172
comments.text: I sat down to this show expecting some good laughs. When really I had to hold back the tears... one of the most incredible pieces of television I have ever seen. Derek was not good looking, he wasn't intelligent, but he was the perfect kind human. It makes you think if more of us thought in his "childish" way, the world would be a lot better place........ Don't even hesitate, watch this and it will change the way you think. As time goes on people will recognise how incredible this show was.

comments.author: @Kelsabell330
comments.text: I work at a memory care facility and I bawled like 10 times because of how realistic this was in terms of what it's like working with old people. What Derek says is true about the job: it sucks because everybody is always dying around you. But it's also true that it's so incredibly worth it to take care of these people and be there for them. They are still people and they deserve to be heard and taken care of. This show is brilliant because very few people these days care about the elderly :(
